source: Rebuilt from https://github.com/bkerler/mtkclient @ ebe450da (2026-08-16) with patches: xflash_lib send_param dsize 0x200 -> 0x10000 (512B USB write chunks caused ~7MB/s cap); Packet length print gated to first call; new wfscatter cmd (MST-style: GPT rebuild from scatter with reserved-from-live + gap-fill, sparse-aware streaming writes, evidence lines); preloader boot writes wrapped as EMMC_BOOT+BRLYT factory format (header reused from device boot1 when present, template fallback; payload at 0x800, region 0x40800) — raw file at LUN offset 0 hard-bricks this platform; multi/script command parsing via shlex (quoted paths with spaces); reset cmd chain: 1) BOOT_TO corrected generic_reboot_payload (84B ARM stub: WDT unlock key 0x1971, interval, SWSYSRST via BOTH keys 0x88<<16 and legacy 0x22<<24, HW watchdog enable as guaranteed-reset fallback, dsb/isb/wfi — BOOT_TO DOES jump: old stub's PC-relative literal was misaligned so WDT writes hit DRAM garbage and it busy-looped = DA-idle look), 2) async DA shutdown (async_mode=1, bootmode=1), 3) BOOT_TO device preloader at 0x200000, 4) sync shutdown — DA SHUTDOWN itself powers off this platform (all dandelion tests); pyinstaller onefile, python 3.14
hardwareValidationNote: 2026-10-21 dandelion (Redmi 9A, MT6765, eMMC CJTD4R). EMMC_BOOT/BRLYT preloader wrap fix HARDWARE-VALIDATED: full MST-parity flash with fixed mtk.exe (2.2.1) — GPT primary+secondary rebuilt, 24 writes incl wrapped preloader→boot1+boot2, Total 5.61 G, Elapsed 7m25s, device rebooted AND booted into Android normally. Prior brick root-caused: factory boot partitions hold EMMC_BOOT+BRLYT wrapper (2048B header, payload at 0x800, region 0x40800 — byte-verified vs Oct-11 factory boot dumps in Backups); raw preloader at LUN offset 0 (old 2.2.0) destroyed the wrapper → bootROM cannot load preloader → hard dead (battery pull no help, BROM still reachable; MST SPFT rescued by writing wrapped form). Fix: handler reuses device's existing EMMC_BOOT header (template fallback == factory header byte-perfect offline) and writes [hdr][payload][zero-pad to region]. Earlier same-day: 19-partition subset (no preloader write) 4.63G/6m25s OK; broken 24-write run 5.61G/6m58s dead. 2.2.3 reset auto-reboot attempts HARDWARE-FAILED on dandelion (2026-10-27): bootmode=1 (HOME_SCREEN) alone → power off; + xflash enablewdt=1 → power off (Userlock Remove + Reset Device tests). 2.2.4 BOOT_TO generic_reboot_payload stub at 0x40000000 also HARDWARE-FAILED (2026-10-27 Reset Device: phone powered off). 2.2.5: reset now BOOT_TO's the device's OWN preloader (mtk.config.preloader, dumped from RAM at BROM connect, EMI-validated) at 0x200000 — the CPU jumps into the normal cold-boot chain (preloader -> lk -> Android); stub + DA shutdown kept as fallbacks; reset cmd prints flush=True (stdout survives hard exit); C# Reset Device button now accepts confirmation line even when exit!=0 (device disconnect during reboot expected). 2.2.5 TEST (2026-10-27): preloader jump path ran (both PMK reset lines printed, boot_to returned True) but NO jump happened — device stayed alive in DA idle (0e8d:2001 COM37, screen black) → BOOT_TO ACK does not guarantee the CPU jump for non-protocol targets. 2.2.6 async-shutdown-first TEST (2026-10-27): async DA shutdown (async_mode=1,bootmode=1) ACKed cleanly, confirmation printed, USB disconnected - but phone STILL powered off (DA firmware on MT6765 ignores reboot intent in shutdown flags). 2.2.7 ROOT-CAUSED the old stub by disassembling generic_reboot_payload with capstone: BOOT_TO DOES jump (stub executed) but its PC-relative literal pointer was misaligned (0x2a instead of 0x2c) so the WDT writes landed on DRAM garbage 0x001a0000 and the stub busy-looped = DA-idle look. New stub assembled with keystone (capstone round-trip verified, 21 insns): unlock WDT key 0x1971, interval, WDT_RESTART, SWSYSRST=0x00880014 (key 0x88<<16) then SWSYSRST=0x22000014 (legacy lk key 0x22<<24) - chip software reset with normal-boot reason - then WDT_MODE=key|EN as guaranteed HW-watchdog fallback, dsb/isb/wfi; reset chain reordered stub-first; PENDING hardware confirmation (2026-10-27 Reset Device test). 2.2.7 stub TEST (2026-10-27): stub line printed at 0x40000000, no boot_to error (status 0 ACK), but device STAYED in DA idle (COM37 alive) = BOOT_TO to plain DRAM addr is ACKed but NOT jumped. 2.2.8: stub moved to the DA extensions address 0x4fff0000 (the ONLY addr the DA provably jumps to - extensions load uses it every session); stub rewritten as infinite retry loop (unlock WDT key 0x1971, interval, loop: kick WDT_RESTART + SWSYSRST via key 0x88<<16 then legacy 0x22<<24 + WDT_MODE=key|EN) - enabled HW watchdog fires in ~125ms even if every SWSYSRST write is ignored; PENDING hardware confirmation. 2.2.9 REBOOT PARITY HARDWARE-VALIDATED (2026-10-27): root-cause of 2.2.8 silent-fail was WRONG WDT register keys - PMK stub wrote WDT_MODE key 0x1971<<16 and SWSYSRST 0x880014/0x22000014, but the device DA's OWN reboot function (MTK_DA_V5.bin @ 0x49a94, disassembled) writes WDT_MODE(0x10007000)=0x22000024 (key 0x22<<24) and SWSYSRST(0x10007014)=0x1209 (matches mtkclient meta.py wdg+0x14<-0x1209). Wrong keys = HW ignores every write = stub busy-loops forever (DA USB stack dead -> Unknown USB Device descriptor error, phone black, no boot). Also fixed: DaHandler has no self.da attribute -> DA object is self.mtk.daloader.da (2.2.8b diagnostic print exposed it: 'stub load failed: AttributeError'). Payload v3 (56B): MODE=0x22000024, ~1M-iter delay, loop { MODE + SWSYSRST=0x1209 + dsb }.
